name: What are the benefits of upgrading to LED lighting in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of upgrading to LED lighting in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading to LED lighting offers several benefits. LEDs are significantly more energy-efficient than traditional incandescent or fluorescent bulbs, leading to lower electricity bills. They also have a much longer lifespan, reducing the frequency of bulb replacements. LEDs provide instant-on light, come in a wide range of color temperatures, and are often dimmable, offering greater control and flexibility over your bathroom's ambiance.
acceptedAnswer.description: LEDs are energy-efficient, have a longer lifespan, offer instant-on light, and provide diverse color temperatures, reducing costs and maintenance.
